# Subway Seat for Vimium

Harvest-gold link hints, a walnut Vomnibar with denim URLs and orange matches, and the find bar and help dialog to match. Selectors follow Vimium 2.x.

[Vimium](https://vimium.github.io) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/vimium/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.css`](subway-seat.css) | `Vimium Options → CSS for Vimium UI` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.css`](subway-seat-tunnel.css) | `Vimium Options → CSS for Vimium UI` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.css`](subway-seat-enamel.css) | `Vimium Options → CSS for Vimium UI` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Vimium Options → Show advanced options → CSS for Vimium UI:

```text
Paste the contents of subway-seat.css and click Save
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Vimium Options → Show advanced options → CSS for Vimium UI:

```text
Paste the contents of subway-seat-tunnel.css and click Save
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Vimium Options → Show advanced options → CSS for Vimium UI:

```text
Paste the contents of subway-seat-enamel.css and click Save
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `Vimium Options → CSS for Vimium UI`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
